test_title: PYST 7: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 14th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Change the sentence from active to passive: **

The committee had been debating complex amendments when the bell rang.

options.text: Complex amendments had been debated by the committee as the bell rang.
Complex amendments had been being debated by the committee when the bell rang.
Complex amendments were being debated by the committee as the bell rang.
Complex amendments had debated by the committee when the bell rang.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The committee had been debating complex amendments when the bell rang."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "complex amendments" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "had been debating" to "had been being debated" (past perfect continuous passive).
 
• Ensure the rest of the sentence "when the bell rang" remains intact for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Complex amendments had been being debated by the committee when the bell rang."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Complex amendments had been debated by the committee as the bell rang." – Incorrect because it changes the tense and omits the continuous aspect.
 
• **Option 3:** "Complex amendments were being debated by the committee as the bell rang." – Incorrect because it uses past continuous instead of past perfect continuous.
 
• **Option 4:** "Complex amendments had debated by the committee when the bell rang." – Incorrect because it uses an incorrect verb form.
